messages:
Anita: heads up — incident triage asked for a full SIEM snapshot for case INC-4829. they want a timeboxed copy for forensic review, storage outside core retention. what's the current policy for ad-hoc evidence snapshots?
Sam: @Anita we have standard log retention 90d in splunk, exports to s3 (30d), and long-term archive cold bucket 365d. ad-hoc snapshots haven't been formalized.
Leo: we usually gate anyexport with a ticket and PO approval. question: do you mean a separate short-term bucket or a signed snapshot with limited access?
Anita: short-term bucket that analysts can use for triage. needs to be encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key (not the global one), and access limited to forensics group + oncall.
Kirin: oncall here — for triage speed we need a 24-72h window by default. longer only with manager + legal sign-off.
James: +1 to timebox. also need an audit trail: who created export, who accessed, when. cannot silently grant S3:GetObject to a large group.
infra-bot: Note: export service creates presigned URLs via sts:AssumeRole -> export role. default expiry is 3600s.
Sam: sketching flow: 1) Analyst opens ticket with justification 2) Infra creates ephemeral S3 prefix under s3://redwood-siem-ephemeral/<ticket>/ 3) Object encrypted with alias/redwood-siem-ephemeral CMK 4) Access granted via short-lived role assuming (STS) 5) Auto-delete (lifecycle) after X days + scrub job.
Anita: sounds reasonable. what should X be? Kirin recommended 24-72h. I lean 7d for edge cases.
Emily: legal: default 72h. extension to 7d allowed but requires written justification on ticket + retention reason. any PII-containing exports must be redaction-reviewed before extending.
Leo: operationally 72h is easy. 7d increases risk if keys rotate or if purge misses. also affects SIEM export costs.
James: add an additional approval for key unwrap access — only security ops can grant Decrypt on CMK for exports with PII.
Sam: example IAM role policy snippet (for reference):
```
{ "Version": "2012-10-17", "Statement": [ {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:PutObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::redwood-siem-ephemeral/${TicketPrefix}/*"}, {"Effect":"Allow","Action":"kms:Decrypt","Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/abcd-ephemeral"} ] }
```
Anita: good — also need audit logs pushed to our audit-sink immediately with an export tag. auditor-bot — can we auto-emit an event to the audit index when an ephemeral export is created?
auditor-bot: yes — export-service already posts AuditEvent:ExportCreated to audit-svc. we can add fields: ticket_id, creator, cmk_key_id, ttl_days.
Kirin: operational checklist idea: 
- ticket with justification + TTL
- infra creates prefix + CMK alias
- analyst gets assume-role creds with ttl <= ticket TTL
- access reviewed by manager if TTL >72h
- auto-purge job runs daily, sends completion event
- ticket closed only after purge event logged

James: who approves CMK usage? we should not let anyone create a new CMK for exports. central security creates and rotates keys. alias/redwood-siem-ephemeral should be used for all ephemeral exports.
Sam: agreed. letting teams create keys increases blast radius. we'll add a guardrail in terraform module to disallow creating CMKs in export workflow.
Anita: last bit — retention labeling. snapshot objects must carry metadata: "evidence: true", "ticket: INC-4829", "expires_at": "2024-11-08T12:00:00Z" so downstream scrubbing can find them.
Leo: tagging done. and add lifecycle rule to delete after expires_at + 1 day to avoid clock skew.
Emily: legal: confirm we log approval chain in ticket and store in retention ledger for audits.
infra-bot: Action created: infra/ENGSEC-472 — implement ephemeral export lifecycle + role policy + audit events. ETA 5 business days.
Anita: thanks all. I'll attach the triage ticket and start the request. please flag any blockers ASAP — we need the snapshot before EOD tomorrow. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
